to.note: Any post-bootstrap task: PHASE-2, PHASE-3 and PHASE-4 roots may start once dependencies are satisfied.

summary: The Section 7 persistent management structure is initialized and validated. The registry holds 7 providers and 90 inventory endpoints (89 eligible, 1 excluded). The roadmap, dependency graph, schedule, critical path, risk register, execution ledger, performance ledgers and handoff contract are in place.
objective: Give the next agent a complete, trustworthy starting state without re-reading the whole workspace.

inputs.why: Source of truth for 7 providers and 89 eligible models.
90 inventory model endpoints plus 7 provider endpoints; 1 endpoint excluded by policy.
DAG edges; use it instead of guessing order.
Top risks R-001 (model isolation), R-002 (AniList), R-003 (offline).
BLK-001 blocks only the PHASE-6 device test.

acceptanceCriteria: Every required .orchestrator directory and JSON file exists.
All JSON parses and carries a schemaVersion.
Registry keeps 7 providers, 90 inventory endpoints, 89 eligible and 1 excluded.
Roadmap covers Smart Matcher, Vault cleanup/classifier, Watchable adaptations, Vault 2.0 and the 10-minute mobile test.
Risk register records model isolation, AniList rate limits and offline fallbacks.

modelPolicy.rule: Validate every proposed model and alias before dispatch. The excluded model is never an orchestrator, worker or backup.

knownRisks: R-001 model isolation violation - hard release blocker if triggered.
R-002 AniList rate limits - throttle, cache, back off.
R-003 offline degradation - cached fallback with a visible notice.
BLK-001 device install requires owner approval before PHASE-6.
openItems: Baseline Smart Matcher metrics must be measured in SM-001; none are recorded yet.
No provider pricing is known; keep cost null.
Two agents (security and release) have no published context limits.
AniList quota behavior is unmeasured until integration tests run.

nextActions.action: Start SM-001: capture the v5.4.1-beta matcher baseline and freeze the scoring contract.
Start VC-001: audit Vault rows, remove duplicates and quarantine ambiguous records.
Start WA-001: define the Anime/Hentai/Kdrama adaptation domain model.
